question: When low-order graph statistics and edit budget are held fixed, does changing which nodes are related disrupt a previously frozen blind hierarchical grammar more than reassigning edge realization attributes while preserving those relationships?

matchedIntervention.candidateSelection: deterministic minimum SHA-256 among valid candidates
eligibility: at least one degree-preserving double-edge swap creates two nonduplicate non-self relationships
matchedIntervention.attributeSwap: keep both endpoint relationships fixed and exchange the two complete edge labels; because multiplicity class is matched, this reassigns normalized length realization while preserving adjacency
matchedIntervention.relationshipRewire: keep each complete edge label but perform one canonical degree-preserving double-edge swap across the same two edges

outcome.instrument: frozen V8 grammar; no rule refit, reordering, or selection
outcome.normalizedPrimary: primary selective penalty divided by max(1, hierarchicalDataBits(original))
outcome.positiveMeaning: the relationship rewrite is less compatible with the frozen grammar than the equally budgeted attribute reassignment
outcome.flatComparator: same selective penalty under the frozen V8 flat dictionary
outcome.topologyDiagnostic: same original versus relationship-rewire penalty under the frozen topology-only hierarchical grammar; attribute swap is intentionally invisible to topology-only labels and is not a primary matched comparison

null.test: deterministic sign flips of each observation's normalized primary selective penalty within lane

adjudication.RELATIONSHIP_CODE_SUPPORTED: all holdout and control support, sign, fraction, and sign-flip gates pass
adjudication.RELATIONSHIP_EFFECT_NOT_DISTINGUISHED: support is sufficient but at least one preregistered gate fails; do not rescue by redefining rendering, context, or code after the result
adjudication.INFEASIBLE: either primary lane has fewer than its frozen minimum eligible matched interventions

falsifier: If a degree/component/cycle/label-inventory matched relationship rewire does not damage frozen heldout grammar fit more than the same-budget realization-attribute reassignment in both untouched lanes, this experiment does not support the claim that protected relationships are the code-bearing layer.
claimBoundary: A pass would support a causal distinction inside the current Mark graph representation between relationship organization and edge realization assignment, using a grammar learned before this intervention. It would not prove historical semantics, conscious machine encoding, universality, or that every glyph is executable code.
